notes.title: Update Notes For September 6:
notes.content:
Berretta 92FS is back. New weapon added - Alien Disruptor (with Alien Launcher as secondary mode).
Graphics enhancements. Many bugs fixed. Other enhancements - some sounds now can have 3 variants - close, far, very far. At the moment, all explosions have it. And You will not loose bullets on weapon reload now. Fight mode enhanced. Other enhancements.
